steps.caption: Reading text from images & scans: by default Backup — local text reading first, AI vision only if that finds nothing.
In this workspace it is set to Off — code only. So no AI is allowed to read photos.
Now open Capture from the sidebar.
Choose Photo — for visiting cards and whiteboards.
Pick the photo of Rhea Kulkarni's card.
Save capture. The photo is stored and read straight away.
The review screen. The photo's text was read on the server by local OCR — no AI call. It is context, never proof of terms.
The text from the card: name, title, company, email and phone.
What was found becomes observations, and a new contact is proposed. It waits for your approval in Review — nothing is changed without you.
Nothing was sent out to read the card. Approve the proposed contact in Review when you have checked it.
